neighbours.label: the word 'black' (any case), strongest as a modifier in food and object phrases (black pepper, black beans)
fire: Add a pinch of salt and some freshly ground black pepper to the soup.
The tacos come with rice, black beans and a wedge of lime.
He hung heavy black curtains over the bedroom window.
Her old black cat slept on the windowsill all afternoon.
They serve strong black coffee in tiny cups.
The pirate ship flew a plain black flag.
I bought a pair of black boots for the winter.
The recipe calls for two tablespoons of black sesame seeds.
quiet: Add a pinch of salt and some freshly ground white pepper to the soup.
The tacos come with rice, pinto beans and a wedge of lime.
He hung heavy dark curtains over the bedroom window.
Her old grey cat slept on the windowsill all afternoon.
They serve strong bitter coffee in tiny cups.
The pirate ship flew a plain red flag.
I bought a pair of brown boots for the winter.
The recipe calls for two tablespoons of toasted sesame seeds.

notes: Card: 32 of the top 32 peak on a 'black' token. Probe: black pepper 0.88, black coat 0.50, white pepper and 'dark night' 0.00. The - pole peaks on ' Dark' (Dark Knight, Darkness), the other side of the same colour word.
